note: Stand-in for shared/contracts/writer/full.json, which is not in this repository. Dimension names are copied from agents/draft_writer_agent.md (Phase 4b). Failure-condition definitions are written by the orchestrator and recorded as decision C10 in paper/config.md.

acceptance_dimensions.name: section_completeness
acceptance_dimensions.requirement: Every section and subsection of the approved outline is present, plus abstract and every mandatory declaration (data availability, ethics, CRediT, conflicts of interest, funding, AI-use disclosure); a [GAP] placeholder counts as present only where the run configuration prescribes it.

acceptance_dimensions.name: citation_density
acceptance_dimensions.requirement: Every factual claim that is not the paper's own result cites at least one source from the verified annotated bibliography; every result number cites its admitted source in the evidence map; no citation outside the verified corpus.

acceptance_dimensions.name: argument_blueprint_fidelity
acceptance_dimensions.requirement: Each claim follows the argument blueprint's claim-evidence-reasoning chain and uses no stronger wording than the blueprint allows; every counter-argument the blueprint lists is handled where the blueprint places it.

acceptance_dimensions.name: total_word_count
acceptance_dimensions.requirement: Body word count within plus or minus 10 percent of the configured target.

acceptance_dimensions.name: per_section_word_count
acceptance_dimensions.requirement: Each section within plus or minus 20 percent of its outline allocation.

acceptance_dimensions.name: acknowledged_limitations
acceptance_dimensions.requirement: A limitations subsection states every limitation the outline and blueprint list, in plain terms.

acceptance_dimensions.name: register_consistency
acceptance_dimensions.requirement: Consistent academic register for the venue; the writing quality checklist of references/writing_quality_check.md is met (no AI-typical filler terms, no em dashes, no throat-clearing openers, varied paragraph length).

must_not: Any number not taken from an admitted gold-label file listed in the evidence map.
Any number from RESULTS.md, a provisional-label file, an undetermined-label file or an external-dataset file.
Any claim of statistical significance for a difference between models.
Any statement of a faithfulness or external-validation outcome while those results are [GAP] placeholders.
Any framing of a result as a negative or null finding; any mention of dead ends, provisional results, retracted analyses or attic work.

failure_conditions.fires_when: Any mandatory dimension (D1, D2, D3, D6) scores block, or any must_not item is violated.
The writer cannot resolve a mandatory-dimension block within its own draft because the inputs do not allow it (for example a required claim has no admitted evidence).
Any dimension scores warn and none scores block.
